name: RISKIND verification benchmark
description: A benchmark comparing verification performance of the RISKIND tool across security verification tasks and scenarios.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific verification benchmark used primarily in formal methods and security verification research rather than the broader ML community.
notes: Non-LLM formal verification benchmark; dataset and scenarios are domain-specific and relatively small; not prone to typical LLM contamination but results are sensitive to modeling of formal semantics.
